note: Instrument-only estimators; no model is involved. The classic 'peak of the pressure-fluctuation intensity' criterion cannot be applied here because the summed standard deviation is still rising at the highest velocity tested (no interior maximum in 0.1-0.9 m/s), which is reported as a result in its own right. The three estimators bracket the bubbling-to-turbulent transition; the value should not be quoted to better than +/-0.1 m/s. The project poster states 0.6-0.8 m/s; this independent re-analysis returns a slightly lower but clearly overlapping band.
